canonical_findings.evidence: Host mutation, effect settlement, context append and checkpoint CAS are separate; terminal effect replay skips handler.
canonical_findings.root_cause: No durable receipt/replay protocol joins activation effect and exposure checkpoint.

canonical_findings.evidence: Existing SQLite catalog stores ProviderToolSpec only and RuntimeServices/checkpoint lack Runtime catalog exposure owner.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Runtime catalog/exposure lack one SQLite owner, migration and resolver.

canonical_findings.evidence: Executable ToolRegistry cannot losslessly model Skill locators and Workflow profile keys.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Tools, Skills and Workflows need discriminated discovery semantics.

canonical_findings.evidence: Current Skill body is ToolResult or SYSTEM, with no private bounded untrusted SDK contribution.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Skill needs body-free receipt and private bounded untrusted contribution.

canonical_findings.evidence: Frozen MCP handler dereferences current session and connect publishes per-tool after marking running.
canonical_findings.root_cause: MCP lifecycle, atomic catalog publication and dispatch incarnation are split.

canonical_findings.evidence: CAP-2 has no URL/title/readiness; CAP-3 has no document/hash/heading/locator oracle.
Plan orders publication before complete Host/UI candidate proof and lacks exact 0.4 backout tuple.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Immutable release lacks reversible prepublish consumer proof and 0.4 rollback.

decisions.rationale: Crash windows cross Host memory, effect ledger and checkpoint; test typed activation receipt replay before choosing transaction shape.
Exact v5-to-v6 migration and restart resolver must be proven with real SQLite state.
Define a closed kind union; only executable Tools project Provider schema.
Add SDK private instruction contribution and body-free activation receipt with negative redaction tests.
Prove incarnation fence and atomic all-or-none server publication under reconnect races.
Freeze exact HTML/Markdown fixtures then prove Tauri Vite, Playwright and attachment paths are observable.
Move complete installed Host/UI proof before publication and preserve exact 0.4 rollback tuple.

conflicts.resolution: Specialist severity P0 supersedes primary P1 because same-schema reconnect can cross physical execution authority and violate AC-23.

required_spikes.purpose: Fault-inject activation/effect/context/checkpoint windows and prove typed receipt replay.
Migrate v5 catalog/active Run to v6 and prove exact static/progressive restart and handler fail-closed.
Prove atomic complete publication and no cross-incarnation dispatch.
Prove deterministic HTML/Markdown fixtures through Tauri Vite, Playwright and real UI attachment/Skill locator.

plan_actions: Make SQLite schema v6 runtime catalog envelope and ReAct exposure the sole durable owners with explicit v5 migration and legacy static mode.
Use typed activation receipt replay, not process-memory mutation, to restore exposure.
Split executable Tool, Skill resource and Workflow profile records; keep Provider names/profile keys distinct from capability IDs.
Add private bounded untrusted Skill contribution; ToolResult/public projections remain body-free.
Give MCP sessions opaque incarnation and atomically publish full server catalogs before running.
Commit deterministic CAP-2 HTML and CAP-3 Markdown fixtures with exact hashes/readiness/trace oracles.
Use final-version two-phase immutable release promotion and tested 0.4 rollback.
